desktop.role: Landscape Chengdu neighborhood approach leading toward the school before An reaches its gate

A path leads into the scene. Include a few lived-in details such as potted plants, a quiet storefront edge, bicycle rack or street lamp, but keep them small and low-contrast. Foreground lower-right and lower-middle should stay calm paved space for two independent character bust sprites. Upper-left should stay simple and low contrast behind an HTML dialogue card. The composition must read clearly as arriving at a school on foot and transition naturally to the closer gate scene. No car, no people, no birds, no text, no signage lettering, no labels, no UI. Match the supplied references: imperfect but consistent hand-drawn dark brown-black ink lines with subtle wobble and varied pressure; simple observed forms; muted flat watercolor in warm cream, faded teal, dusty sage, ochre, tan and soft gray; fine restrained paper grain; gentle ambient daylight. Keep the contours and leaf shapes simplified, the shadows soft, and the detail density quiet. Avoid hyper-detailed rendering, glossy surfaces, hard sun shafts, dramatic lighting, oversaturated colors, polished anime, photorealism, vector smoothness, and any generated characters.
